provenance.asset_description: Bronze statue of a heroic looking Black woman, standing arms crossed with a confident grin on her face. Vines and plants grow over the plaque at the statue’s base. And a lich, flush with divine power, stands ready to do battle. A huge, jagged shard of supernaturally empowered metal pierces her chest.
